# PSY Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Middelfart)

PSY Psykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Middelfart) is a psychiatric outpatient clinic in Middelfart, Denmark, that appears in the ADHD-databasen's 2024 national quality report as one of the treatment units assessed against the database's quality indicators for adult ADHD care [^src1][^src2]. Its most notable feature in the data is a strikingly low score on Indikator 10: the clinic completed only 3 of 42 relevant treatment courses (7%, confidence interval 1-19) in assessing patients' social support needs within 120 days of treatment start [^src1]. This places the clinic among the lowest performers nationally on that measure, at a time when the indicator itself was being reported for the first time and showed widespread shortfalls across the country — a national fulfilment rate of just 37% against a 90% quality target, with regional rates ranging from 14% to 52% [^src1].

By contrast, on a separate indicator reported later in the same document — likely reflecting treatment with ADHD medication within 120 days of pakkeforløb start (Indikator 11) — the clinic performed far better, completing 33 of 42 relevant courses (79%, confidence interval 63-90) [^src2]. The steering group behind the ADHD database discussed possible causes for the low results on the social-support indicator, including registration practices and data quality issues linked to child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinics and private hospitals, and decided to work on improving registration practices going forward [^src1]. The wide swing between the clinic's very low score on one indicator and its much higher score on another mirrors a broader pattern noted in the source material, where regional and clinic-level results varied significantly — a pattern the report attributes at least partly to differences in registration practices rather than genuine differences in clinical care [^src1][^src2].

No relationships or additional claims involving this entity are recorded in the available data beyond the two indicator results described above.
